in_sanskrit.name: जयमीन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जय: victory, मीन: mind, thought, or mountain; One who has a victorious mind or is invincible.

in_hindi.name: जयमिन
in_hindi.long_meaning: जय: victory, मीन: mind; A name meaning 'victorious mind'.

in_tamil.name: ஜயமின்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஜயம்: victory, இன்: mind; A name meaning 'one who has a victorious mind'.

in_telugu.name: జయేమిన
in_telugu.long_meaning: జయ: victory, ఎమి: mind; A name meaning 'one who has a victorious mind'.

in_marathi.name: Jaimin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Conqueror of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaimin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaimin is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'jaya' meaning victory, and 'manas' meaning mind. The name Jaimin signifies one who conquers the gods with his intellect and wisdom.
